title: Sales Intern CRE
desc:
Are you an engineering student looking for an exciting 1-year internship in a multinational company?We are currently looking for a Sales Intern for our SOLIDWORKS Sales team based in our beautiful office in Istanbul. You will face challenges and tasks in a dynamic and international environment!
Role & Responsibilities
Manage Inside Sales activities, including customer follow-ups, sales calls and presentations
Manage certification activities and related processes
Generate and qualify leads to identify new business opportunities
Implement new initiatives and track their results and impact, in order to support the development and execution of projects.
Maintain and improve customer and product data quality and accuracy
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Aerospace, or related Engineering fields
Strong English verbal and written communication skills
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel
Basic knowledge of IP, Domains, IT Systems and Software Licensing types
Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills
Ability to work independently and/or within a collaborative team structure
What's In It For You
Monthly reimbursement and lunch tickets
Hybrid working policy, with two remote working days per week
International and fun environment
Interested? Click on "Apply" to upload your application documents!
Inclusion statement

It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging.
